motifs.name: group_vitality_mass_advantage
motifs.description: Scores connected groups by liberty-weighted mass minus crowding and low-liberty penalties, returning True if the evaluated side leads by at least 22 vitality points.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'group_vitality_mass_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Scores connected groups by liberty-weighted mass minus crowding and low-liberty penalties, returning True if the evaluated side leads by at least 22 vitality points.'
def motif(board_rows: list[str], color: str) -> bool:
    opp = 'W' if color == 'B' else 'B'
    dirs = ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1))

    def score(s: str) -> int:
        seen = [[False] * 19 for _ in range(19)]
        total = 0
        for r in range(19):
            row = board_rows[r]
            for c in range(19):
                if row[c] != s or seen[r][c]:
                    continue
                seen[r][c] = True
                stack = [(r, c)]
                size = 0
                libs = set()
                while stack:
                    cr, cc = stack.pop()
                    size += 1
                    for dr, dc in dirs:
                        nr, nc = cr + dr, cc + dc
                        if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19:
                            v = board_rows[nr][nc]
                            if v == '.':
                                if len(libs) < 80:
                                    libs.add((nr, nc))
                            elif v == s and not seen[nr][nc]:
                                seen[nr][nc] = True
                                stack.append((nr, nc))
                L = len(libs)
                lc = L if L < 5 else 5
                live = max(0, lc - 1) * size
                crowd = 2 * max(0, size - L)
                low = 3 * max(0, 4 - L) * size
                total += live - crowd - low
        return total

    return score(color) - score(opp) >= 22

motifs.name: edge_zone_radial_influence_advantage
motifs.description: Scores empty edge-zone intersections by inverse-distance weighted stones within a 3x3 Chebyshev radius and returns True if the evaluated side controls at least five more edge-zone points than the opponent.

motifs.name: thick_contact_fight_support_advantage
motifs.description: For each same-color stone orthogonally adjacent to an enemy stone, scores its local support by same-color stones within Manhattan distance two capped at four plus a base contact point, returning True if the evaluated side leads this contact-thickness score by at least ten.

motifs.name: eye_security_capture_pressure_advantage
motifs.description: Scores stones with true-eye life and capture pressure from strong adjacent groups; returns True if the evaluated side leads by six combined secure/attacking points.

motifs.name: crosscut_splitting_pressure_advantage
motifs.description: Detects 2x2 diagonal crosscuts and scores ones where the evaluated side's diagonal stones belong to stronger groups than the opponent's diagonal stones, weighting by opponent mass, liberty margin, and connected-splitting shape, returning True if the evaluated side leads this crosscut pressure by at least five with at least eight points.

motifs.name: low_liberty_group_attack_coverage_advantage
motifs.description: Finds enemy groups with exactly 2 or 3 liberties and counts their liberties touched by strong same-color attacker stones, returning True if the evaluated side leads this attack-coverage score by at least 5 with at least 6 of its own.

motifs.name: diag_backed_weak_liberty_threat_advantage
motifs.description: Counts same-color stones with at least one diagonal same-color supporter of a distinct group with 3+ liberties, that are orthogonally adjacent to a liberty point of a weak opponent group (3 libs or fewer), weighted by supporter count, weak-liberty count, and proximity to atari, returning True if the evaluated side leads by at least three with at least four attacker-pressure points.

motifs.name: core_supported_cluster_dominance
motifs.description: Weights each stone by a compact-connectivity index over orthogonal links (base 2) plus diagonal links (base 2), scaled +2/-2 per stone, and returns True when the evaluated side leads by at least nine weighted points.

motifs.name: enclosed_interval_attack_pressure_advantage
motifs.description: Scores same-color or edge-bounded row/column empty intervals of length 2-7 and attack pressure from low-liberty groups, returning True if the evaluated side leads the combined differential by at least 16.

motifs.name: group_linking_keypoint_advantage
motifs.description: Computes group IDs and sizes once, then counts empty intersections orthogonally adjacent to two or more distinct same-color groups (combined size at least four) with no opponent stone directly adjacent, weighting each by group count and total size, returning True if the evaluated side leads by at least three with at least four.

motifs.name: floodfill_territory_dominance_advantage
motifs.description: Floodfills empty regions and scores each by capped area times net unique border-stone advantage, halving edge-touching regions, returning True if the evaluated side leads by at least 6 with at least 8 score.

motifs.name: dual_strong_attacker_encirclement_advantage
motifs.description: Counts opponent stones in groups adjacent to two or more distinct same-color groups of at least three stones with at least three liberties, weighted by attacker count and a low-liberty bonus, returning True if the evaluated side leads this encirclement score by at least four with at least five.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'dual_strong_attacker_encirclement_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Counts opponent stones in groups adjacent to two or more distinct same-color groups of at least three stones with at least three liberties, weighted by attacker count and a low-liberty bonus, returning True if the evaluated side leads this encirclement score by at least four with at least five.'

def motif(board_rows, color):
    opp = 'W' if color == 'B' else 'B'
    D = ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1))
    seen = [[False]*19 for _ in range(19)]
    gid = [[-1]*19 for _ in range(19)]
    gc = []
    gs = []
    gl = []
    n = 0
    for r in range(19):
        row = board_rows[r]
        for c in range(19):
            ch = row[c]
            if ch == '.' or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            st = [(r,c)]
            libs = set()
            sz = 0
            while st:
                cr, cc = st.pop()
                if seen[cr][cc]:
                    continue
                seen[cr][cc] = True
                gid[cr][cc] = n
                sz += 1
                for dr, dc in D:
                    nr, nc = cr+dr, cc+dc
                    if 0<=nr<19 and 0<=nc<19:
                        v = board_rows[nr][nc]
                        if v == ch and not seen[nr][nc]:
                            st.append((nr,nc))
                        elif v == '.':
                            libs.add((nr,nc))
            gc.append(ch)
            gs.append(sz)
            gl.append(len(libs))
            n += 1
    
    def enc(att):
        tgt = 'W' if att == 'B' else 'B'
        adj = [set() for _ in range(n)]
        for r in range(19):
            row = board_rows[r]
            for c in range(19):
                if row[c] != tgt:
                    continue
                g = gid[r][c]
                for dr, dc in D:
                    nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
                    if 0<=nr<19 and 0<=nc<19 and board_rows[nr][nc] == att:
                        adj[g].add(gid[nr][nc])
        t = 0
        for g in range(n):
            if gc[g] != tgt:
                continue
            s = sum(1 for a in adj[g] if gs[a] >= 3 and gl[a] >= 3)
            if s >= 2:
                w = s - 1 + (1 if gl[g] <= 4 else 0)
                t += gs[g] * w
        return t
    
    own = enc(color)
    oth = enc(opp)
    return own - oth >= 4 and own >= 5

motifs.name: opp_heavily_surrounded_ko_groups_count
motifs.description: Counts distinct opponent groups whose perimeter is dominated by evaluated-side stones with no eye space and very few liberties, returning True if the opponent has more such surrounded weak groups than the evaluated side has and at least two opposing ones.

motifs.name: direct_atari_capture_mass_advantage
motifs.description: Counts stones in one-liberty atari groups for each side and returns True if the opponent has at least three more atari stones than the evaluated side.

motifs.name: intergroup_safe_knight_link_advantage
motifs.description: Counts safe knight-move links between distinct same-color groups with at least four liberties and both shoulder-cut points free of opponent stones; returns True if the evaluated side has at least four more such intergroup links than the opponent.

motifs.name: edge_capture_press_advantage
motifs.description: Counts opponent stones on the first two edge lines that have a same-color stone directly perpendicular toward the center within two steps and whose group has at most eight liberties, returning True if the evaluated side leads by at least two with at least two of its own.

motifs.name: opponent_pinched_double_contact_advantage
motifs.description: Counts opponent stones orthogonally adjacent to at least two same-color stones with no orthogonal friendly support and a friendly majority on the diagonal points, returning True if the evaluated side leads this pinch score by at least three with at least four.

motifs.name: shape_defect_differential
motifs.description: Counts empty triangles (three same-color stones filling three corners of a 2x2 box with the fourth empty) and isolated low-liberty stones as shape defects; returns True if the opponent has at least three more defects than the evaluated side.

motifs.name: hane_head_of_stones_pressure_advantage
motifs.description: Counts same-color stones orthogonally adjacent to an enemy stone that has another enemy neighbor (head of stones) where the same-color stone has a diagonal same-color supporter, returning True if the evaluated side leads hane-attack points by at least two with at least two of them.

motifs.name: fourth_line_backed_third_line_stance_advantage
motifs.description: Counts evaluated-side stones on the third line from an edge that have a same-color stone on the adjacent fourth-line square (offset -1 to +1 perpendicular to that edge) plus a same-color stone within two steps along the same third line, returning True if the evaluated side leads by at least two and has at least three such stable fence stances.

motifs.name: star_point_zone_control_advantage
motifs.description: Scores influence over the nine standard star points using nearby stones with distance decay; returns True if the evaluated side controls at least two more star-point zones than the opponent.

motifs.name: cardinal_enclosed_opponent_stones_advantage
motifs.description: Counts opponent stones for which the evaluated side has a stone first along at least three of four cardinal axes before another opponent stone or board edge appears within six steps, returning True if the evaluated side leads by at least three.

motifs.name: nearest_stone_influence_area_score
motifs.description: Estimates area score using alive stones, nearest-stone squared Euclidean controlled empty points, and atari stones, returning True if the evaluated side is ahead by at least 5 points.

motifs.name: diagonal_chain_open_framework_barrier_advantage
motifs.description: Counts straight diagonal same-color chains of length>=3 with large perpendicular open space and minimal opponent contact; returns True if the evaluated side leads this diagonal-framework score by at least 5 with at least 6.

motifs.name: eyeless_squeezed_encirclement_advantage
motifs.description: Detects opponent groups of size>=3 with 0-1 true eyes whose outside liberties all touch evaluated-side stones, with an adjacent stronger same-color group, returning True if evaluated side leads this encirclement mass by at least 5 with at least 8 of its own.

motifs.name: cardinal_enclosure_dominance
motifs.description: Counts empty intersections where the nearest stone within five steps along at least two cardinal directions belongs to the evaluated side and no opponent stone appears in any cardinal direction; returns True if evaluated side leads by at least five such points.

motifs.name: rank8_quiet_safe_dominance
motifs.description: Counts rank-8 canvas adjacency for each side (default weak=3.0, winrate 0.55) with double bonus, subtract 2x rank-7, plus safe temple counts minus vulnerable temple counts, and the evaluated side leads by at least 4.

motifs.name: supported_head_cap_pressure_advantage
motifs.description: Counts supported same-color stones capping the ends of opponent runs of length at least two along rows or columns, with no opponent branch beside the capped end; returns True if the evaluated side leads weighted cap pressure by at least four.

motifs.name: thin_cutting_wedge_advantage
motifs.description: Counts small same-color stones (group size <=5, liberties >=3, at most one orthogonal same-side neighbor) orthogonally adjacent to at least two distinct opponent groups with one sized three or more; returns True if the evaluated side has at least two such wedges and at least one more than the opponent.

motifs.name: long_wall_run_advantage
motifs.description: Sums quadratically weighted lengths of orthogonal same-color stone runs of length at least 4 along rows and columns; returns True if the evaluated side leads the opponent by at least 6 weighted points.

motifs.name: isolated_medium_liberty_siege_pressure_advantage
motifs.description: Scores enemy groups with three to five liberties that lack a nearby stronger same-color helper and are in orthogonal contact with a stronger same-color attack group, weighted by stones, contacts, and liberty deficit, returning True if the evaluated side leads this siege pressure by at least four with at least five.

motifs.name: moyo_corridor_between_parallel_walls_advantage
motifs.description: Counts empty intersections in 1-3 wide vertical or horizontal corridors bounded by same-color stone runs of length at least 2 in distinct groups along the perpendicular axis, returning True if the evaluated side leads by at least 3 with at least 4.

motifs.name: strong_group_open_expansion_headroom_advantage
motifs.description: For each same-color group of at least three stones with at least four liberties, counts its liberty points that are themselves adjacent to at least three empty intersections (open expansion headroom), returning True if the evaluated side leads by at least four with at least six.

motifs.name: center_diagonal_fortress_eye_set_advantage
motifs.description: Counts central-region empty intersections (rows 5-13, cols 5-13) with at least three of four diagonal neighbors being same-color stones backed by a strong group with at least four liberties and at least two orthogonal empty sides, weighted by supporting-group strength; returns True if the evaluated side leads this central-fortress score by at least two with at least three fortress points.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'center_diagonal_fortress_eye_set_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Counts central-region empty intersections (rows 5-13, cols 5-13) with at least three of four diagonal neighbors being same-color stones backed by a strong group with at least four liberties and at least two orthogonal empty sides, weighted by supporting-group strength; returns True if the evaluated side leads this central-fortress score by at least two with at least three fortress points.'

def motif(board_rows, color):
    opp = 'W' if color == 'B' else 'B'
    D = ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1))
    DIAGS = ((-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1))
    seen = [[False]*19 for _ in range(19)]
    gid = [[-1]*19 for _ in range(19)]
    gsz = []
    glib = []
    n = 0
    for r in range(19):
        for c in range(19):
            if board_rows[r][c] == '.' or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            ch = board_rows[r][c]
            st = [(r,c)]
            seen[r][c] = True
            libs = set()
            sz = 0
            while st:
                cr, cc = st.pop()
                gid[cr][cc] = n
                sz += 1
                for dr, dc in D:
                    nr, nc = cr+dr, cc+dc
                    if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19:
                        v = board_rows[nr][nc]
                        if v == ch and not seen[nr][nc]:
                            seen[nr][nc] = True
                            st.append((nr, nc))
                        elif v == '.':
                            libs.add((nr, nc))
            gsz.append(sz)
            glib.append(len(libs))
            n += 1

    def score(side):
        total = 0
        for r in range(5, 14):
            for c in range(5, 14):
                if board_rows[r][c] != '.':
                    continue
                gids = set()
                diag_side = 0
                for dr, dc in DIAGS:
                    nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
                    if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19 and board_rows[nr][nc] == side:
                        diag_side += 1
                        gids.add(gid[nr][nc])
                if diag_side < 3:
                    continue
                ortho_empty = 0
                for dr, dc in D:
                    nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
                    if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19 and board_rows[nr][nc] == '.':
                        ortho_empty += 1
                if ortho_empty < 2:
                    continue
                strong = [g for g in gids if glib[g] >= 4 and gsz[g] >= 2]
                if not strong:
                    continue
                distinct = len(gids)
                total += 1 + len(strong) + min(distinct - 1, 2)
        return total

    own = score(color)
    oth = score(opp)
    return own >= 3 and own - oth >= 2

metadata.score_definition: P(motif=True | winning) - P(motif=True | losing), preserved from the canonical discovery ranking.
